name: Asymmetric Modular Pulse Hashing
description: Replaces the easily factorable linear pulse equation with a highly asymmetric cubic/quadratic modular equation that evaluates to the same truth table for the domain {1,2,3}. This prevents the model from algebraically simplifying the condition to s_u != s_v, forcing it to either evaluate the domain explicitly or attempt to solve the non-linear modular equation.
